text:
maria: noticing apiserver 503 spike in eu-west1 / controller-manager leader-election jitter, etcd leader election also noisy since 03:58 UTC
ajay: yep, graphs show etcd wal_fsync latency spikes ~700ms coinciding with high outbound connection errors from the provisioner
jamie: node logs show a ton of conntrack drops and 'nf_conntrack: table full' on nat-gw-2
lee: conntrack_count peaked ~130k, ephemeral ports exhausted on NATs -> TCP resets to our attach endpoint
paul-sre: we rolled a kernel patch earlier this week that disabled BPF offload on some NAT hosts; could have reduced conntrack capacity unexpectedly
sre-bot: Incident opened: INC-20260322-078 (eu-west1 apiserver 5xx + etcd election jitter). Pagerduty: ops-oncall
ops-oncall: mitigations in progress: 1) spin up 3 extra NAT gateways 2) sysctl tuning to raise nf_conntrack_max 3) enable conntrack gc aggressive mode
maria: can someone paste the quick sysctl we did?
ajay: applied: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=250000` and `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=120`
jamie: also added raw table NOTRACK rule for internal attach traffic to bypass conntrack for pod->gpu-attach: `iptables -t raw -I PREROUTING -s 10.0.0.0/8 -d 10.128.0.0/9 -p tcp -j NOTRACK` (temp; will audit)
lee: quick health check: etcd leader election latency dropped to ~180ms after NAT scale + conntrack tune, apiserver 5xxs down to baseline in last 4m
paul-sre: follow-up: kernel BPF offload revert in canary group and eBPF conntrack helper re-enabled on 2 hosts to validate capacity differences
maria: controller-manager backlog peaked ~200 pods waiting for GPU attach, now at ~18 and draining
ops-oncall: cost note: extra NATs running ~0.55k USD/hr in eu-west1 while active; plan to tear down after 30m stable
ajay: recommend provisioner change: detect net-egress saturation and throttle attach concurrency + backoff jitter to avoid retry storms
jamie: agree. I'll open SRE ticket to add a circuit breaker on attach API and a flag to skip conntrack for trusted internal flows (SRE-442)
paul-sre: also file to revisit kernel patch gating in our cloud images pipeline; unexpected BPF change should be caught earlier
maria: quick reminder: etcd fsync spikes might've amplified control-plane timeouts; add alert for wal_fsync > 500ms -> page on-call
ops-oncall: marking mitigated for now, will monitor 60m before cleanup. Recording runbook steps in INC-20260322-078
sre-bot: INC-20260322-078 status: mitigated at 04:06 UTC
lee: action items: 1) revert temp iptables NOTRACK after audit 2) PR for provisioner backoff + attach concurrency 3) kernel gating ticket 4) cost analysis for reserved NAT capacity
maria: thanks team. Good catch on ephemeral port exhaustion vs app bug. We'll follow up in SRE-442 and SRE-443 for postmortem and action items.
